build_Pipe: build a pipeline pipe stage that applies a callable function to each incoming item with configurable concurrency
build_Aggregate: build an aggregation stage that batches incoming items into lists of a specified size before emitting
build_Merge: build a merge config that combines multiple pipeline configs into a single output queue
build_PathVariants: build a path variants stage that routes items to different processing paths based on a router function
build_PipelineConfig: build a complete pipeline config by composing a source, pipe stages, and a sink buffer
